name: UController.newOrganization adopts another organization's Reputation
summary: DAOstack's shared UController owns the Reputation, native token and Avatar of every organization registered with it. Its newOrganization(avatar) is permissionless: it adopts whatever nativeReputation and nativeToken the supplied avatar reports and registers the caller as a full-permission scheme. It never checks that the Reputation already belongs to another organization. The attacker registered a fake avatar that reported Genesis Alpha's real Reputation and minted itself 20,000 REP through the UController, about 67% of the new supply. It then passed a SchemeRegistrar proposal installing itself as a scheme on the real Genesis Alpha avatar, and had the UController send the avatar's 4.025 ETH.

loss.notes: The Genesis Alpha avatar's entire ETH balance (4.025 ETH at block 26059089, 0 at 26059090), sent to the attacker contract by UController.sendEther. A copycat, 0x9240fa3939a2… (block 26059353), used the same newOrganization path with its own fake avatar and moved only dust GEN and WETH, under 1 USD; it is not valued.

ageReset.description: Genesis Alpha's creation transaction transferred ownership of its Reputation (log 122), native token and Avatar (log 119) from the DaoCreator 0x82c5a168d431ff6e43e5c2b2fe29bdfd58dd4d64 to the UController. UController ownership of that Reputation is what makes its mint path reach the victim's governance.

limitations: UController bytecode is unverified; newOrganization's behaviour is established from the exploit trace and the DeFiHackLabs fork reconstruction.

sources.note: Root cause, target and anchor. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 26059090, index 4, contract creation by EOA 0x5cf6bf41 -> factory 0xa90bbd7f): the logic contract 0x304a8e57 creates fake avatar 0xd9902ea5 (which creates decoys 0x7f7d02dd and 0x20aef079), then calls UController 0xd5bee5d9 newOrganization (0xb9981364) with the fake avatar. The UController reads its owner (0x8da5cb5b), nativeReputation (0x89ae1c90) and nativeToken (0xe1758bd8) and accepts it. mintReputation (0xeaf994b2) makes the UController call mint (0x40c10f19) on the real Genesis Alpha Reputation 0x6256294145fb529db7b248eb86b4e6ef30f55bf9. SchemeRegistrar 0x781f48f3 proposeScheme (0x1c940d51) and GenesisProtocol 0xfbaef31b vote (0x9ef1204c) execute to register the attacker scheme on the real avatar 0x7b11dfb29504abc8c0dfa60dc7e0aa2aae836db0; then sendEther (0x634965da) makes the avatar send 4.025 ETH to 0x304a8e57, forwarded to the EOA. At block 26059089, owner() of the Reputation and of the Avatar is the UController. Age: eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-2).contractAddress = UController (block 5727359, index 9, creator 0x73db6408); eth_getCode empty at 5727358; keccak256(runtime) = 0x8832233b4bae2975d1aabec15330a01de40d6bedde949a385e28348536a35fb1 at 5727359 and 26059089; not a proxy. Reputation, Avatar and GDT token were created in source-3 (block 5727369, index 11), whose OwnershipTransferred logs (Reputation log 122, token log 121, Avatar log 119) move ownership from DaoCreator 0x82c5a168 to the UController; Reputation slot 0 (owner) holds the UController from 5727369, and Etherscan getLogs shows no later OwnershipTransferred on these three. Earliest exercise: Etherscan getLogs of all 40 UController events from 5727369 to 26059353 give MintReputation (0xeb0f295d) for Genesis Alpha by its GenesisProtocol and schemes at blocks 5827789 and 5875048. The only MintReputation events for another avatar are source-1 (fake avatar 0xd9902ea5) and the copycat 0x9240fa3939a2… at 26059353 (fake avatar 0xa958bd4c).

Loss. eth_getBalance(avatar 0x7b11dfb29504abc8c0dfa60dc7e0aa2aae836db0) = 4025000000000000000 at block 26059089 and 0 at 26059090. The trace shows the avatar's value transfer of 4.025 ETH to 0x304a8e57, then to factory 0xa90bbd7f and EOA 0x5cf6bf41. Valued at DefiLlama coingecko:ethereum 2688.0445840372763 (quote time 1790394820).
